title: safety_release
description: The receiver released an edge push button that Crosscheck had pressed down in its sim, because the other pilot's up never arrived (30 s cap) or the link was lost. The only write no pilot made (docs/protocol.md section 5). The server raises a red desync safety_release to both pilots. (client to server)

cause.description: cap: no up within 30 s. link_lost: this bridge lost the server. peer_lost: the other pilot was lost.

observed.description: The button's value after the release (even = up).
